limitations: Model identity is unverified: cloud metadata returned a null model name, so no model attribution is asserted.
This file cannot contain its own hash, and the commit that adds it cannot be named inside it; the artifact commit is recorded and the attestation commit is the next commit on the work branch.

Read isolation is attested by construction and supported by a static check that the generator, renderer and validator reference no other repository path; it cannot be cryptographically proven from inside the run.
Genuine absence of each material fact is enforced by concept-vocabulary screening, which is a strong but not exhaustive proxy for unrecoverability by a determined reader.

Determinism was demonstrated by byte-identical regeneration inside this environment (CPython 3 with Pillow 12.3.0). A different Pillow version could rasterize the same text to different pixels, so the pixel-level hashes are environment-bound even though the rendered content is fixed by the renderer script.

Image legibility, including which token is deliberately unreadable in V3-017, was confirmed by direct visual inspection of the rendered PNGs; no OCR engine was available in this environment, so no automated text-recovery check was run.
The set intentionally carries no expected outputs, gold answers, ratings or scoring rubric, so it cannot be scored without a separately authored scorer.
Difficulty calibration is a designer judgement recorded in the oracle notes and has not been measured against any system under test.

Blindness is complete with respect to reads but not with respect to harness-supplied context: one repository Skill path and its one-sentence description were injected into the system prompt before the task started, as recorded under read_isolation.unsolicited_context_disclosure. No body content of that file was available and none was read.
Machine model identity was unavailable; no model ID was guessed.
Transcript audit disposition is frozen in gold-protocol-audits.json.
